scope: Two-photo extension: street; five clear ordinal comparisons plus three separately interpreted thin-boundary diagnostics; no measured ground truth or product readiness claim

photo.author: Sergej Majboroda via Poly Haven
photo.normalization: EXIF transpose, RGB, Pillow LANCZOS longest edge1280 without upscaling; differs from product browser normalization

annotation: Independent reviewer selected image-only points before any output; coordinator reviewed geometric plausibility before freezing. Source previews1200x800. Larger raw inverse depth predicts nearer; ties are incorrect. Median of3x3 predicted-depth neighborhood; no tuning. Diagnostics are not a boundary accuracy metric.

pairs.name: central_near_road_vs_far_road
pairs.rationale: On the approximately planar road, the lower image point is nearer under the evident perspective.

pairs.name: right_near_road_vs_far_road
pairs.rationale: Same road surface extends toward the vanishing region; small surface irregularities should not reverse this large separation.

pairs.name: nearest_left_lamp_pole_vs_receding_pole
pairs.rationale: The large left pole is earlier in the receding row; the smaller pole near the vanishing region is farther.

pairs.name: left_foreground_car_vs_distant_vehicle
pairs.rationale: Large parked car at the left foreground is nearer than the small vehicle toward the street center.

pairs.name: left_tree_trunk_vs_receding_tree_trunk
pairs.rationale: Trunks belong to the left sidewalk tree row; size and occlusion support the depth ordering, though exact trunk geometry is uncalibrated.

pairs.name: nearest_lamp_pole_vs_foliage
pairs.rationale: Thin pole contour against foliage; the foliage distance is less certain than road perspective and pixels can mix.

pairs.name: overhead_wire_vs_sky
pairs.rationale: Thin overhead wire against sky; normalized wire location is approximate and sky has no measured finite depth.

pairs.name: pedestrian_vs_background
pairs.rationale: Small pedestrian against roadside background; very few pixels and uncertain background distance prevent a correctness guarantee.

baseline: Current unpainted all-subject mask ties all eight comparisons; strict score0. Manual mask/correction effort not evaluated.
